register.heading: Sign up for TeaStream
register.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
register.usernameDescription: This is the name other users will know you by.
register.emailDescription: We may use your email to send you messages about your account.
register.passwordDescription: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
register.successAlertDescription: A confirmation email has been sent to your email address. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.

login.heading: Log in to TeaStream
login.backButtonLabel: Don't have an account? Sign up
login.pinDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.loginDescription: The username or email you used when signing up.
login.passwordDescription: The password you used when signing up.

resetPassword.heading: Reset password
resetPassword.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
resetPassword.emailDescription: The email you used when signing up.
resetPassword.successAlertDescription: We've sent a password reset link to your email. If you have Telegram notifications enabled, the link was also sent there.

newPassword.heading: New password
newPassword.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
newPassword.passwordDescription: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
newPassword.passwordRepeatDescription: Repeat your new password to confirm it.

deactivate.heading: Account deactivation
deactivate.pinDescription: A code has been sent to your email. If you have Telegram notifications enabled, we sent the code there as well.
deactivate.emailDescription: The email you used when signing up.
deactivate.passwordDescription: The password you used when signing up.
deactivate.successMessage: You have successfully deactivated your account

header.heading: Settings
header.description: Here you can manage your settings

header.heading: Profile
header.description: Customize your profile, update your avatar, edit your bio and add links to your social networks to make your page more appealing to other users.

avatar.heading: Profile picture

confirmModal.heading: Delete avatar
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to delete your profile picture? This action cannot be undone.

avatar.info: Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF. Max size: 10 MB.

info.heading: Profile settings
info.usernameDescription: This is the name other users will know you by.
info.displayNameDescription: Capitalize letters in your username as you like.
info.bioDescription: Your bio must be no longer than 300 characters.

createForm.heading: Social links
createForm.urlDescription: Where does this link go? Enter the full URL, e.g. https://github.com/Kiwious

header.heading: Account
header.description: Manage your account settings, including access changes, security and deactivation options.
header.securityDescription: Set up two-factor authentication for better protection of your data.
header.deactivationDescription: If you want to temporarily or permanently disable your account, use this option. Please note the consequences.

email.heading: Email address
email.emailDescription: Enter your new email address. Make sure it is valid, as a confirmation will be sent to it.

password.heading: Account password
password.oldPasswordDescription: Enter your old password to confirm your identity before changing your password. This is necessary to keep your account secure.
password.newPasswordDescription: Your new password must be at least 8 characters long. Using special characters is also recommended for better security.

twoFactor.heading: TOTP authentication
twoFactor.description: Increase your account security by enabling TOTP authentication. This extra layer of protection requires entering a unique code, making your account less vulnerable to unauthorized access.

enable.heading: Enable TOTP
enable.qrInstructions: Scan the QR code to add TOTP
enable.pinDescription: Please enter the 6-digit code provided by your authenticator app.

disable.heading: Are you sure you want to disable TOTP?
disable.message: Disabling TOTP authentication will make your account less secure. Are you sure you want to continue?

deactivation.heading: Account deactivation
deactivation.description: After deactivating your account, you will not be able to log in. After 7 days, the account will be permanently deleted. Until then, you can contact support to restore access and unlock your account.

confirmModal.heading: Confirm deactivation
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to deactivate your account? Access can only be restored within 7 days.

header.heading: Appearance
header.description: Customize the look of the site to your liking. Choose a theme and language that make your experience more comfortable.

theme.heading: Change theme
theme.description: You can choose a dark or light theme for the site.

language.heading: Site language
language.description: Choose the language that will be used on the site.

color.heading: Accent color
color.description: Choose an accent color for the interface.

header.heading: Notifications
header.description: Configure how you want to receive notifications from TeaStream. You will be notified when channels you follow start streaming, as well as about new followers.

siteNotifications.heading: Site notifications
siteNotifications.description: If you turn off site notifications, you will not receive notifications about new followers of your channel or about new streams.

telegramNotifications.heading: Telegram notifications
telegramNotifications.description: If you enable Telegram notifications, your TeaStream account will be linked to your Telegram account, and you will receive messages about new followers, new streams, password resets and two-factor authentication codes.
